dedupe_keys.name: battery cell and module thermal runaway measurements by ageing

description: The battery thermal-runaway team publishes synchronized temperature, pressure and force measurements for fresh and aged lithium-ion cells and modules. The public OSF node lists one Dataset_TR archive. The article describes CSV files for cylindrical and pouch nickel-manganese-cobalt cells, with 100% and 86% state-of-health groups and a test-time column. Licence: CC0-1.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. Coverage is the laboratory test configurations, not every electric-vehicle pack or grid-storage installation. The measurements can calibrate thermal and mechanical failure components in battery safety or infrastructure resilience simulations. A caveat is that the article's Data availability sentence contradicts its Data Record by saying no datasets were generated; the own OSF node and detailed record confirm a deposited archive. The archive was not downloaded, and sensor uncertainty was not recalculated. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
